name: Epsilon Eridani
notes: Western constellation line-figure star (HIP 16537; Stellarium Eri). SIMBAD identity * eps Eri; SIMBAD compiled Johnson V=3.73; Bailer-Jones EDR3 geometric posterior median distance; absolute V uses no extinction correction. Adopted coordinate/motion bundle: nearest-100:epsilon-eridani. Epsilon Eridani reviewed physical parameters. Baines & Armstrong (2012) combine the Navy Precision Optical Interferometer angular diameter with bolometric flux and the Hipparcos parallax for the temperature, radius and luminosity, and fit Yonsei-Yale isochrones for the mass. Santos et al. (2004) measure [Fe/H] spectroscopically. Mamajek & Hillenbrand (2008) estimate 0.4 Gyr from chromospheric activity and 0.8 Gyr from activity-inferred rotation; the adopted 0.6 +/- 0.2 Gyr spans both. The Gaia DR3 model values (5002 K, [M/H]=+0.13, 7.3 Gyr) remain in source provenance but are not adopted: the isochrone age contradicts the star's activity and rotation, and the positive abundance contradicts the measured sub-solar [Fe/H]. Adopt the reviewed component-scoped literature parameters instead of the Gaia DR3 model values, whose isochrone age and positive [M/H] contradict the star's youth and measured sub-solar abundance.
